entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I may have won today, but I did[n]catch you off-guard somewhat.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I imagine you're not too pleased[n]with how that turned out...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Whenever I have time, I'll be[n]in Shibuya Station Square.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...If I'm to truly win, I want to[n]defeat you at your full strength.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So if you'd like a rematch,[n]I will accept.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Rematch...? What were you two doing[n]in Mementos?
